snippet.title: C.A.G.E. – Gameplay Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Deliver the package. Ignore the bees. Do not stare at the visual irregularities.
WISHLIST C.A.G.E. ON STEAM NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4641290

________________________________________________________________________

C.A.G.E. is a satirical first-person narrative adventure where your choices influence the story. Guided by an entity with questionable morals, you must navigate through corporate gaslighting and environmental oddities to complete your tasks. Your empathy is a glitch, compliance is your currency.

Will you be the perfect employee, or will you become a glitch in the system?

________________________________________________________________________

C.A.G.E. is a solo developer passion project made with love for the dark, bizarre and satirical kind of comedy. The main character is voiced by the talented Daniel Quinton (DQVO).
